date: "2025-11-11"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(readxl)

letty_data <- read_xlsx("data/CDI_asd.xlsx",skip = 1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ends_with("age")),
               values_to = "age",
               names_prefix = "V" ) %>%
   pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("produced"),
               values_to = "nProduced") 


```
